concept: A list of actions that opens from a button, the menu sheet with rows that nest its corner and a groove between groups.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a white dropdown with grey hover rows and a 1px border (Bootstrap dropdown) as the menu
default_to_avoid.why_not: a white box with grey rows owns colours the glass does not, and its rows do not nest its corner

derivation.consequence: opaque page, raised and sunken surfaces; no blur
derivation.form: the menu is the opaque sheet of Select so its actions read on any scene

derivation.consequence: corners are continuous and nest, so an inner surface's radius is the outer radius minus the padding between them and a pane inside a pane reads as inside it; controls are full pills because they are held in the hand
derivation.form: its rows nest the sheet’s corner by the inset, the rule from R-008

derivation.consequence: one solid fill exists, the loud solid (white in dark, ink in light); a promoted action is the same solid glowing with its own light, and a pane uses one of them
derivation.form: a critical action alone takes the critical mark colour and comes last

options: A Select’s sheet with grouped rows
variants.picked: A Select’s sheet with grouped rows
variants.reason: A is one family with Select (D-017). B brings white and grey. C makes rows unreadable over a busy scene.

sheet.why: the opaque menu sheet over the page, on the float shadow

item.why: each action is a 44px row whose corner nests the sheet’s

critical.why: the action that destroys something, in the critical mark colour, last

icon.why: an icon at the icon size before the label

label.why: the action’s name, taking the free width, the same in every theme and on every scene

shortcut.why: the keyboard shortcut in secondary text at the end of the row

separator.why: a groove between groups, the same etched line as Divider

data-highlighted.why: the highlighted row is a lighter pane lit on its top edge

data-disabled.why: a disabled action uses the shared disabled opacity

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours outline the sheet and the highlighted row

@sheet-in.why: the sheet drops a short way from its trigger and settles
